activity.notes: TDV reports 698 as the prevalent appointment date for Musa's governorship of Ifriqiya and records his departure from al-Andalus for Damascus in 714 after the western conquests. Other reference traditions place the formal governorship later, so ATLAS preserves 698 as approximate rather than fabricating false precision. The relation is service under the Umayyad Caliphate; representative_domain remains the reviewed military classification.

sources.citation_text: TDV identifies Musa ibn Nusayr as a leading Umayyad commander, gives 698 as the prevalent date of his appointment over Ifriqiya and the Maghreb, and records his recall from al-Andalus in 714.

sources.title: Musa ibn Nusayr — Repertorium Saracenorum, University of Cologne
sources.citation_text: The University of Cologne repertory identifies Musa ibn Nusayr as an Arab military commander and governor in Ifriqiya and preserves the variant chronology around his governorship.
